title: Direct Immutable Parameter/Forcing View Feasibility & Qualification
goal: Determine whether the qualified F-MR20 V1 worker path can replace worker-local parameter/forcing value refresh copies with read-only direct registry views without changing physics, state, transaction semantics, mass accounting, deterministic publication or parallel admission scope.
hard_constraints: registry-backed views are read-only for the full solve lifetime
no parameter_set_id shortcut unless separately proven as a content-validity key
no alias to committed dynamic state
no alias to mutable result or solver scratch

qualification_plan.phase_A_source_ownership_audit: Map all parameter/forcing copies and pointer lifetimes from runtime registry through backend/provider bindings; classify immutable versus mutable/recomputed payload.
qualification_plan.phase_B_feasibility_probe: Test read-only view binding only where lifetime and mutation rules are source-proven. Fail closed for derived MvG data or any payload requiring worker-local recomputation.
qualification_plan.phase_C_scientific_gate: Run full frozen F-MR20 V1 scientific matrix under O0/O2 and require exact serialized/candidate state, result, diagnostics and mass identity plus true 2/4-worker overlap.
qualification_plan.phase_D_timing: Only after scientific PASS, run paired timing against F-PE09 exact-shape cache reuse. Timing is runner-bound characterization, never a portable speedup guarantee.

initial_hypothesis.geometry_arrays: candidate for direct immutable view if registry lifetime is stable
initial_hypothesis.raw_cofgen: candidate only if provider can separate immutable raw input from worker-local derived coefficients without mutating registry storage
initial_hypothesis.forcing_arrays: candidate for direct immutable view if all admitted providers read-only and forcing lifetime spans the solve
initial_hypothesis.derived_MvG_coefficients: not assumed directly viewable; currently require recomputation/cache semantics until proven otherwise
